metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2015 · Mr. Holmes
metas.description: An aged, retired Sherlock Holmes deals with dementia, as he tries to remember his final case, and a mysterious woman, whose memory haunts him. He also befriends a fan, the young son of his housekeeper, who wants him to work again.

metas.name: ★ 2.6 · 2002 · Home Alone 4: Taking Back the House
metas.description: Amidst his parents' impending divorce, Kevin McCallister must foil his old nemesis Marv and his wife Vera's plot to kidnap a Crown Prince.

metas.name: ★ 2.6 · 1999 · Baby Geniuses
metas.description: Scientists hold super intelligent talking babies captive, but things take a turn for the worse when a mix-up occurs between a baby genius and its twin.
